chapter: Playing with Punch Miller and touring
title: Punch Miller, the Iron Man, and touring by car
summary: Morris worked with Bunk in Thibodaux; Punch was called the Iron Man, and touring by automobile to Texas was grueling.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: When did you work with Bonk?
I worked with Bonk out there in Tipido a couple of times, but Bonk used to be here. Uh huh.
Yeah. Whose band was it in Tipido that you worked with?
What did Punch play like in those days?

Did he have the same style like now or the different style? Mute or anything? Well Punch... Punch was... He had a nice style. You see that show ruined Punch. You know that's the part of it. Okay, well let's go that thing.
Yeah. Yeah, that... That show ruined Punch. You know the punch stood away over 20 some years on that show. Yeah. He played a different style. Different style, yeah.

Well, if we'd have been playing regular now, he'd have done come out of the way. But Punch was... Punch was... They called him the Iron Man. Used to call him the Iron Man. Yeah, and we had a good band. What did the Iron Man mean?
Play so hard and play so much.

We used to be so tired we'd have slept side to live in. And... Yeah, that show ruined Punch. Yeah, that show ruined Punch. Yeah, that show ruined Punch. You know the punch stood away over 20 some years on that show. Yeah, he played a different style. Yeah, different style. I remember. Different style, yeah. That show ruined him. Well, if we'd have been playing regular now, he'd have come back to us. But Punch was... They called him the Iron Man.
They used to call him the Iron Man. Yeah, and we had a good band.

They played so hard and played so much. We used to be so tired we'd have slept side to live in. Coming in, the automobile break. We'd just get on the side of the level, the side of the road, out the way and go to sleep. I see once we was going to... We was going to Gowards, Texas in the automobile. Seven passing a car. And when we got to Morgan City, we wore out two tires. So we was lucky enough to buy two more. We said, well, we're going to hike on anyhow. And we stopped in Beaumont. We played there. Well, we made good money. The next day, we helped the man buy him two tires. And that's why we'd hike on out. We went to Port Austin. We played there two nights. We just was making them stop, you know. But I never want to go that far in the morning, the automobile. Oh, you'd be broke down. And you got all the instruments. Them kind of used to have them seven passing a car, you see. We had plenty of room. And all the instruments tied on there like an Egyptian. So there you go. We just went right on. And that's the way it was.
